settings.content: Popup on first visit + rotating top banner, switched on automatically between the dates below (use Melbourne time, e.g. 2026-11-27T00:00:00+11:00). Preview any time by adding ?bf_preview=sale or ?bf_preview=monday to a store URL. Sale prices themselves come from compare-at prices in Shopify admin.
